cluster_summary: This cluster consists of vulnerabilities where network protocol code either fails to validate size/length fields from external input, leading to buffer overflows or unbounded allocation, or mismanages resource cleanup and lifecycle, causing leaks or accounting imbalances, or handles errors in a way that leads to resource abuse or security bypass.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Ensure proper cleanup on all exit paths, add finalize() methods, deregister when interest becomes zero, and execute pending jobs before removal to trigger correct accounting..

mechanism.missing_guard: the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect
mechanism.name: Resource lifecycle mismanagement causing leaks or accounting errors
mechanism.sink_shape: the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs
mechanism.typical_fix: Ensure proper cleanup on all exit paths, add finalize() methods, deregister when interest becomes zero, and execute pending jobs before removal to trigger correct accounting.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Ensure proper cleanup on all exit paths, add finalize() methods, deregister when interest becomes zero, and execute pending jobs before removal to trigger correct accounting.
sub_patterns.name: Resource lifecycle mismanagement causing leaks or accounting errors
sub_patterns.root_cause: Cleanup or deallocation of resources (native memory, file descriptors, counters) is not performed on all code paths, such as missing finalizers, missing deregistration of epoll fds, or missing counter restoration when jobs are discarded.
